section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (Study X) with 228 Black female undergraduate college students (M age = 19.89) recruited from psychology courses at a large, urban Mid-Atlantic university. BMI was calculated from self-reported height and weight (M = 24.71), and data were collected online via SONA Systems. All participants were college students (100%), and none identified as White (0%).
